title: loop_entry
description: Loop bookkeeping that most consumers can ignore: one piece of the loop's own work (an agent step, a tell to the owner, or a task) changed status. Written by the loop's ledger. Never a stage or progress; it shows the device is at work, and the loop rebuilds its ledger's tells and tasks from it after a lost store.

kind.description: agent-step: an agent ran one step of an issue; tell: a message to the owner; task: a wake of the loop's model outside a planned step.

key.description: The ledger key: the work's identity across retries, for example i92/ltn0brb/review/0821e6a/r2/a1.

attempts.description: Attempts of this key so far.

class.description: The planner's class for the work.

rule.description: The planner rule that planned it, for example S2 or S3.

ended_at.description: When it ended; null while running.

agent_id.description: The agent's id, for an agent step; null otherwise.

wake.description: The wake's name, for a tell or task, for example parked; null otherwise.
